newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Maniguin well yields gas traces.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Maniguin well yields gas traces.

text.p: The Philippines' Maniguin-3 oil and gas prospect has yielded traces of methane and ethane in early drilling, the Energy Department said on Monday.
"Gas shows from C1 (methane) to C2 (ethane) were encountered in the drilled interval," energy resource development bureau director Griselda Bausa said in a bulletin.
The onshore drilling reached a depth of 2,610 feet (803 metres) over the weekend, an advance of 815 feet since Friday.
The traces of gas came in the last 815 feet.
The well is being operated by state-owned Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp.

Other members of the drilling consortium include Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp, the Petrofields Exploration & Development Co Inc, Asian Petroleum and Minerals Inc, a subsidary of Asian petroleum Corp, and Basic Petroleum and Minerals Inc.
